capabilities: Search GIFs by keyword via the Klipy API
Browse trending GIFs and curated categories
Insert a GIF as a Markdown image at the cursor
Open the picker via command palette, right-click menu, ribbon icon, or hotkey
Configure results per page, locale, and an auto-generated User ID for personalization
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes a network and privacy disclosure stating no vault content is transmitted, and installation via BRAT is documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search for and insert GIFs into notes while writing.

relations.evidence: This plugin connects to the Klipy API (api.klipy.com) to retrieve search results

summary: GIF picker that searches the Klipy API by keyword or trending categories and inserts GIFs as Markdown images at the cursor.
